context_requirements: Functional L-type calcium channel complex (CACNA1C with auxiliary subunits) or CACNA1C-dependent calcium entry
Excitable or calcium-responsive cell context; most immortalized lines have low L-type channel expression
Sustained depolarization or channel activation sufficient to raise cytosolic calcium
Intact calcium-dependent signaling to CREB/NFAT/MEF2 and stress-response pathways
falsifiers: No reproducible transcriptional response at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Immediate early gene induction (FOS, EGR1, JUN) at 6 h that is not seen with known L-type activators
Strong proliferation or cell-cycle gene changes at 6 h, which would suggest a direct cytotoxic rather than calcium-channel mechanism
Line-response pattern opposite to CACNA1C expression or L-type channel function
